title: Teachmint Paid Features Alternative: Free Trials (2026)
description: Want Teachmint-style paid features without paying upfront? Teachmint lists no prices, so we compare free trials, no-upfront-fee plans and free tools, with sources.
og_description: Teachmint's site lists no prices. Here is what you can honestly get free: trials, plans with no upfront fee, and free tools, plus what each costs once you start selling. Every figure from an official page, checked 24 Oct 2026.
h1: Teachmint Paid Features Alternative (2026): What You Can Honestly Get Free
dek: Teachmint does not list its prices, and no full coaching platform we checked is free for good. Here is what you can get without paying upfront: free trials, plans that charge only a commission, and free tools, with what each costs once you sell.
cover_alt: Teachmint paid features alternative: free trials, no-upfront-fee plans and free tools compared, prices checked 24 Oct 2026
audience: Teachers, tutors and coaching institute owners in India looking for a free or low-cost alternative to Teachmint's paid features
intro: None of the coaching platforms we checked gives you a full paid stack (your own app, website, live classes, tests and payments) free for good, but you can start without paying upfront. AllCoaching gives a 14-day free trial with no card, Edmingle a 7-day free start, Exly's Starter plan and TagMango's Basic plan charge no fixed fee and take a commission on sales instead, and free tools such as YouTube Live, Google Forms and WhatsApp cover the basics if you stitch them together.

Teachmint itself does not list prices. Its website, as it loaded for us on 24 Oct 2026, leads with Teachmint X, an AI classroom device, and asks you to book a demo. Its India pages did not load from our connection, so an India price list cannot be ruled out. Ask Teachmint directly what its paid plan costs.

We are AllCoaching, so read this knowing who wrote it. AllCoaching is not free either: after the 14-day trial you pick a yearly plan from ₹6,999 plus GST. Every other figure below comes from the company's own website, linked and dated, and we say plainly where another option costs less than ours.
takeaways: Teachmint lists no plans or prices on the pages we could load (checked 24 Oct 2026); its site leads with Teachmint X and a "Book a Demo" button.
AllCoaching gives a 14-day free trial with no card; then Starter ₹6,999, Growth ₹12,999 or Pro ₹24,999 a year plus a 10%, 7.5% or 5% fee on sales, GST extra.
Exly Starter has no upfront fee and takes a 10% commission; TagMango Basic has no fixed fee, takes 10% and is capped at 200 students.
On published prices, Exly Starter costs less than AllCoaching up to about ₹5 lakh of sales a year, before add-ons; Exly's own mobile app and custom website are add-ons from ₹60,000 a year each.
Every AllCoaching plan already includes your own domain and your own Android and iOS app, plus unlimited live classes and UPI checkout.
Free tools are genuinely free (YouTube, Google Forms, WhatsApp), but they give you no checkout, no academy website and no app of your own.
Edmingle offers a 7-day free start and Learnyst's buttons say "Get started for free"; both charge once you choose a plan.

sections.h2: The short answer: free to start, not free for good
sections.html:
If you want Teachmint-style paid features without paying upfront, pick by how you want to pay once students start buying.

{{fig:verdict|Teachmint paid features alternative by need: own website and app with a free trial, AllCoaching; pay nothing until you sell, Exly Starter; zero cost and no checkout needed, free tools; classroom device for a school, stay with Teachmint|Pick the row that sounds like you. The sections below explain the catch in each.}}

Every option has a catch. Trials end, commission plans take a share of each sale, add-ons cost extra, and free tools leave you to collect fees by hand. The rest of this guide shows each catch with the numbers.

We looked at what coaching educators usually pay for when they say "paid features" and checked each option on its own website on 24 Oct 2026.

  1. Cost to start: free trial, no upfront fee, or a plan price.
  2. Cost once you sell: plan price plus any commission on sales.
  3. Your own brand: website on your own domain and your own Android and iOS app, included or an add-on.
  4. Teaching tools: live classes, recorded courses, tests and notes.
  5. Payments: whether students can pay by UPI or card inside your academy.
Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide. Competitor figures link to their official pages and carry the date we checked them (24 Oct 2026). Prices change; check the source before you decide. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in and we will correct it.

sections.h2: What Teachmint offers today, and what it costs
sections.html:
Teachmint's website, as it loaded for us on 24 Oct 2026, leads with Teachmint X, which it calls an "AI-Powered Connected Classroom Device": an interactive board with EduAI tools for schools, higher education and coaching.[1]

Its pricing address, teachmint.com/pricing, redirected us to that product page with a "Book a Demo" button and no plans or prices. The India version of the site did not load from our connection, so Teachmint may show an India price list there. We could not confirm one.

{{q:Is Teachmint free?|We could not confirm it either way. The Teachmint pages we could load list no plans, prices or free features and ask you to book a demo. Ask Teachmint in writing which features are free, what the paid plan costs, and whether GST is extra.}}

That matters for this comparison. Because Teachmint publishes no plan, we cannot say which of its features are paid. What we can do is show what the common paid features (own app, own website, live classes, tests, payments) cost elsewhere, and what you can get free.

If you run a school or a classroom and want a smart-board device, Teachmint is built for that, and none of the options below is a like-for-like replacement.

{{fig:before-after|Before and after: free tools stitched together, with classes on one app, fees on UPI screenshots, notes in Drive and tests on Google Forms, compared with one academy login with your own website, app, live classes and checkout|Free tools work, but you run five of them. An academy platform puts them in one login.}}

sections.h2: 6 ways to get Teachmint-style features free or with no upfront fee
sections.html:
Here is each option as its own company describes it, with what you pay to start, what you pay once you sell, and the catch.

Our platform · disclosure

1. AllCoaching: 14-day free trial

Good at
An academy you build yourself, like Shopify for coaching: your own website on your own domain, your own Android and iOS app, courses, tests, notes, unlimited live classes (YouTube Live, Zoom or the built-in room) and UPI checkout in one studio.
Published price
Starter ₹6,999/yr + 10% on sales, Growth ₹12,999/yr + 7.5%, Pro ₹24,999/yr + 5%; GST extra. Pricing
Free to start
14-day free trial, no card needed.
Catch
It is a trial: after 14 days you choose a paid yearly plan. Below about ₹5 lakh of sales a year, a commission-only plan such as Exly Starter costs less, if you do not need your own app.
Best for
Educators who want their own brand, website and app included, and to set it up themselves.

2. Exly: no upfront fee on Starter

Good at
Storefront, payments, CRM and WhatsApp and email automation for coaches; it calls itself "an all-in-one solution to all things business".
Published price
Starter: no annual upfront fee + 10% commission; Pro ₹30,000/yr + 6%; Premium ₹1,08,000/yr + 3%. GST not stated.[2]
Free to start
Yes on Starter; you pay through commission.
Catch
A mobile app (iOS and Android) is an add-on from ₹60,000/yr, a custom website from ₹60,000/yr and white-labelled branding from ₹20,000/yr.
Best for
Coaches selling sessions and courses who are happy with a storefront and do not need their own app yet.

3. TagMango: no fixed fee on Basic

Good at
Courses, community and automation for coaches, with optional branded apps; it says a custom domain goes live "24 hours from onboarding".
Published price
Basic: no fixed fee + 10% commission (including the Indian payment gateway), capped at 200 students; Pro ₹5,000/month + 5.5%; all + GST.[3]
Free to start
Yes on Basic; the page says "Book a Call".
Catch
A custom domain needs the Freedom Setup at ₹24,999 a year on top of a plan, and branded apps are a ₹74,999 + GST setup.
Best for
Coaches building a small paid community who can start on a TagMango address.

4. Learnyst: "Get started for free"

Good at
Courses, mock tests and live classes with test series; it pitches "Features required to market and sell your content online".
Published price
Launcher ₹10,000/yr + 10% of sales ("No monthly fee"); Professional ₹8,999/month (₹8,099/month billed annually) with 0% transaction fees; taxes extra.[4]
Free to start
Its buttons say "Get started for free"; a trial length is not stated.
Catch
A branded Android app starts on Premium (₹14,999/month), and apps are published under Learnyst's developer account.
Best for
Exam academies where mock tests are the main product.

5. Edmingle: 7-day free start

Good at
An "AI-powered LMS purpose-built for professional training and skilling businesses", with batches, branches and white-labelled academies.
Published price
Core ₹7,499/month, Prime ₹14,999/month, Power ₹29,999/month, billed annually; taxes extra.[5]
Free to start
7 days.
Catch
A fee on sales is not stated; a branded Android app starts on Prime and a branded iOS app on Power.
Best for
Training businesses and larger institutes that need detailed operations features.

6. Free tools stitched together

Good at
YouTube for recorded and live lessons, Google Forms for quizzes, Google Meet for small live classes and WhatsApp groups for notices and doubts.
Published price
Free to use with a Google or WhatsApp account; each has its own limits.
Free to start
Yes, and they stay free.
Catch
No checkout, so fees arrive as UPI screenshots; no academy website, no app of your own, and students juggle five links.
Best for
A teacher testing demand with a first batch before paying for anything.

sections.h2: What "free to start" costs once you sell
sections.html:
We cannot chart Teachmint, because it lists no price. The chart shows what the options with published prices cost at five sales levels, taking the lowest-cost plan each time.

{{fig:cost|Total yearly cost at sales levels up to ₹10 lakh from published prices for AllCoaching, Exly, Learnyst and Classplus|Before GST and before add-ons. Exly's line does not include its paid app or custom website add-ons.}} {{cost_table}}

The honest reading: if you only need a storefront, Exly's Starter plan costs less than AllCoaching up to about ₹5 lakh of sales a year, by at most ₹6,999, because it has no upfront fee. Above about ₹5 lakh, AllCoaching's Pro plan costs less. TagMango Basic takes the same 10% as Exly Starter, within its 200-student cap. Classplus is on the chart because many teachers compare it with Teachmint: its listed ₹29,999 a year has no free start on its pricing page, and it is lower than AllCoaching only above about ₹2.3 lakh of sales a year.

The picture changes if you want the features people usually mean by "paid": your own app and your own website. On Exly, those are add-ons from ₹60,000 a year each; on TagMango, a custom domain is ₹24,999 a year and branded apps are a ₹74,999 setup. Every AllCoaching plan already includes both. Learnyst's Launcher costs more than AllCoaching at every level on the chart. Run your own numbers in our plan finder.

sections.h2: Which free or low-cost option fits you
sections.html:
You are testing your first batch

Use free tools or a free trial. A CBSE tuition teacher or a yoga instructor can run a first batch on YouTube Live and WhatsApp, or build the whole academy inside AllCoaching's 14-day trial and see how it feels. Our guide on how to sell courses online in India covers the first sale.

You want to pay nothing until students pay

Exly Starter and TagMango Basic are built that way. Check the add-on prices for anything branded you will need later.

You want your own app and website from day one

For an SSC or banking educator building a brand, an academy with your own domain and app included costs less than adding them separately. See LMS with a custom domain and what a white-label coaching app costs.

Your academy is mostly mock tests

Look closely at Learnyst, and compare with building tests inside your own academy. See how to create mock tests online.

You run a school or a physical classroom

Teachmint's classroom device is aimed at you. Ask Teachmint for a written quote and compare it only with other classroom tools.

sections.h2: How to move from Teachmint or free tools to your own academy
sections.html:
The safe way to move is to build first and move students batch by batch. Current students keep using what they have until their batch ends.

{{fig:switch|Four steps to move from Teachmint or free tools: build your academy in the free trial, run both side by side, move new admissions, close the old setup after the last batch|Build inside the free trial, so you only pay once you are sure.}} {{steps}}

The full checklist, including messages to send students, is in how to switch coaching apps without losing students.

items: Build your academy in the trial
Start the 14-day free trial, connect your domain and upload one complete course with a free demo lesson.
Keep current students on Teachmint or your free tools until their batch ends, so nobody loses access.
Send new admissions to your academy
Share your own website and app link on WhatsApp, YouTube and Instagram for every new batch.
Export your student and fee records, then stop the old tools or plan after the last batch.

faq: Is there a free alternative to Teachmint's paid features?

Not one that is free for good with a full paid stack, among the platforms we checked. You can start free with AllCoaching's 14-day trial or Edmingle's 7-day start, pay only commission on Exly Starter or TagMango Basic, or use free tools such as YouTube Live, Google Forms and WhatsApp.

Teachmint does not list prices on the pages we could load on 24 Oct 2026; its site leads with Teachmint X and asks you to book a demo. Its India pages did not load from our connection, so ask Teachmint for a written quote.
No. AllCoaching has a 14-day free trial with no card, then Starter ₹6,999, Growth ₹12,999 or Pro ₹24,999 a year plus a 10%, 7.5% or 5% fee on sales, GST extra.
Which Teachmint alternative has no upfront fee?

Exly's Starter plan has no annual upfront fee and takes a 10% commission, and TagMango's Basic plan has no fixed fee, takes 10% and is capped at 200 students. Branded apps and a custom domain cost extra on both.
Does AllCoaching include a white-label app and custom domain?
Yes. Every AllCoaching plan includes a website on your own connected domain and your own white-label Android and iOS app, plus unlimited live classes and UPI checkout.
Can I run coaching on free tools only?
Yes, for a small batch. YouTube, Google Forms, Google Meet and WhatsApp are free to use, but you collect fees by hand, have no academy website or app of your own, and students juggle several links.
Is AllCoaching good for live classes and tests?
Every AllCoaching plan includes unlimited live classes through YouTube Live, Zoom or the built-in live room, plus recorded courses, PDF notes and test series in the same studio.
How do I move from Teachmint to my own academy?
Build your academy during the 14-day trial, keep current students where they are until their batch ends, send new admissions to your own website and app, then export records and close the old setup.

An Android or iOS app that carries your brand's name and logo, built on a platform's technology.
Your own web address, such as youracademy.in, connected to your academy website.
A feature sold separately on top of a plan, such as a branded app or custom website.
